title: Can I BEAT Martin with Castling Checkmate?
summary: Self-imposed challenge: spin a wheel to pick a random bot (every slice says 'Martin'), then checkmate it BY CASTLING. He must never move his king or the castling rook all game. He wins Martin's queen, strips his pieces, pawn-storms, sacrifices his own queen at one point, picks up both of Martin's promoted queens, then switches plans from long to short castling and delivers O-O checkmate with the rook (after Qg8 driving the king to e7/f6).
rules: Normal chess vs Martin (250), standard start.
The game only counts if the final move is a castling move that delivers checkmate (rook gives mate).
Implicit constraints: never move the king or the chosen rook; avoid checks that force a king move; avoid stalemate.
Any other checkmate doesn't complete the challenge (inferred; he keeps playing to set up the castle mate).
win_condition: Checkmate Martin with castling (O-O or O-O-O).
